name: My Biggest Fan
source:
Juno is a relatively functional woman. She goes to work at a chain restaurant, has a small group of friends, and watches a vtuber named Venus Knight. She's got her problems, of course, but she'd argue she copes… decently. Not great, but decent. She has a massive parasocial relationship with Venus, but she considers that acceptable enough.

Venus Knight's gimmick is she's an alien, here to have fun and maybe save a few humans! She's got her eyes set on one human in particular, a woman who definitely, definitely needs her help.

One night, annoyed about a stream cancellation, Juno is walking home, when a girl with a familiar voice stops her.  

[From [url=https://hearticorn.itch.io/my-biggest-fan]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朱诺是一个相对功能性的女性。她在一家连锁餐厅工作，有一小群朋友，并观看一个名为Venus Knight的vtuber。当然，她也有自己的问题，但她认为自己能够……得体地应对。不是很好，但还不错。她与金星有着广泛的准社会关系，但她认为这是可以接受的。

维纳斯骑士的噱头是她是一个外星人，来这里是为了享受乐趣，也许还能拯救一些人类！她特别关注一个人，一个绝对需要她帮助的女人。

一天晚上，朱诺对直播取消感到恼火，正走在回家的路上，一个熟悉声音的女孩拦住了她。

[来自[url=https://hearticorn.itch.io/my-biggest-fan]itch.io[/url]]
